title: Legal entity finance attributes
requirement: Each legal entity (a Foundation organisation unit of type legal entity) shall carry finance attributes: entity code, tax registrations, default currency, default chart of account, billing and shipping addresses, numbering initials, logo for documents.
rationale: Documents belong to a legal entity; numbering and templates depend on it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a legal entity without default chart of account, When a request is created for it, Then the user must choose a chart of account and is told why.|Given a duplicate entity code, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given numbering initials set, When a document is numbered with the dynamic prefix on, Then the initials appear in the number.

title: Chart of accounts and segments
requirement: Finance administrators shall define charts of account per legal entity with ordered segments (name, length, data type, allowed values or value ranges, mandatory), buying group, billing address, and default match levels for products and services.
rationale: Account strings are built from segments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a chart with three segments, When an account string is entered, Then each part is validated against its segment values.|Given a chart of another legal entity, When selected on a document, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given segment values changed, When existing documents are viewed, Then their strings are unchanged.

title: Account strings
requirement: Valid account strings shall be stored as master records (string, segment values, owner, active) so that budgets, lists and reports reference them; invalid combinations shall be refused and inactive strings shall not be selectable on new lines.
acceptance_criteria: Given an inactive string, When a line is coded with it, Then it is refused with the status shown. (error case)|Given a new combination allowed by segment rules, When first used, Then it is created as a master record (if the setting allows) or refused (if the setting requires pre-defined strings).|Given a string owner, When a budget line owner is not set, Then the string owner is used as the dynamic approver.

title: Budget periods
requirement: Finance administrators shall create budget periods (name, start, end, owner, status Open or Closed) per legal entity; closed periods accept no new reservations.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Open period, When a line is split to it, Then it is accepted.|Given a Closed period, When a new request uses it, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given overlapping periods for one legal entity, When saved, Then a warning is shown (overlaps allowed for quarters inside years).

title: Budget lines
requirement: Budget lines shall be unique per budget period and account string, with owner, amount, reserved, consumed and available, and a consumption history with document references.
acceptance_criteria: Given a duplicate period and string, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given amount 100,000 with reserved 20,000 and consumed 30,000, When viewed, Then available shows 50,000.|Given history requested, When viewed, Then each row shows document type, number, amount and event (reserved, confirmed, released).

title: Budget availability check with reservation
requirement: When a request, non-order invoice or other budget-relevant document is submitted and budget validation is on for its type, the system shall lock the budget lines in a fixed order, compute required per split, compare with available, block or warn per configuration, and reserve the required amounts in the same transaction.
rationale: Gap: race conditions in the current product.
acceptance_criteria: Given two requests submitted at once against the last 1,000 available, When processed, Then one succeeds and the other is refused (blocking) or warned (warning mode).|Given no budget line for a string with validation on, When submitted, Then "No budget line exists for account string X" is shown. (error case)|Given warning mode, When exceeded, Then submission proceeds, the shortfall is stored on the document and shown to approvers.

title: Budget consumption and release
requirement: Reservations shall become consumption at approval (or at submission when configured), be released on rejection, cancellation or close-short, be transferred from request to order to invoice without double counting, and be reversed by credit notes.
rationale: Correct available budget at all times.
acceptance_criteria: Given an approved request later converted to an order and invoiced, When viewed, Then the budget line shows one consumption, not three.|Given a request cancelled, When processed, Then its reservation is released.|Given a credit note approved, When processed, Then consumption decreases by its amount. (edge)|Given a release attempted for a reservation that no longer exists, When processed, Then it is refused and reported as an integrity error. (error case)

title: Budget adjustments and transfers
requirement: Permitted users shall adjust a budget line (positive or negative, reason mandatory) or transfer between lines in one action, never below consumed plus reserved, with approval when configured.
acceptance_criteria: Given an adjustment that would make available negative, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a transfer of 10,000 from A to B, When approved, Then A decreases and B increases by 10,000 with one audit trail.|Given adjustments, When listed, Then actor, reason and time are shown.

title: Fiscal calendar
requirement: Fiscal years with periods (no overlaps, no gaps) per legal entity, with open and closed states; documents carry the fiscal period of their date; closed periods refuse new documents dated inside them unless the user has the permission to post into closed periods.
acceptance_criteria: Given periods with a gap, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a document dated in a closed period, When created by a user without the permission, Then it is refused.|Given a document, When viewed, Then its fiscal period is shown.

title: Categories and commodities
requirement: A category tree with management groups and a commodity hierarchy mapped to categories shall classify items, request lines, suppliers and contracts and shall be usable in approval conditions and reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given a category with a management group, When a request line of that category is submitted, Then the group can be resolved as approvers.|Given a duplicate category name under the same parent, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a commodity moved, When viewed, Then its items keep the mapping.

title: Currencies and exchange rates with revisions
requirement: Currencies (code, decimals, symbol) and exchange rates (from, to, chart of account or legal entity, validity range, rate) shall be maintained through a revision workflow (draft, submitted, approved, applied), with a rate feed connector as a later option; conversions use the rate valid on the document date.
acceptance_criteria: Given a revision approved, When applied, Then rates are valid from the start date.|Given overlapping validity for the same pair and scope, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given no valid rate, When a line is converted, Then the save is refused with the pair and date named.

title: Tax codes and classifications
requirement: Tax codes with components and rates, validity and country, tax classifications for items and services (such as harmonised codes), and a place-of-supply rule setting shall drive tax lines on orders and invoices; totals round per currency decimals using half away from zero; country-specific rule sets (Indian GST with CGST, SGST and IGST by place of supply) are delivered as accelerator packs (FF-176).
rationale: Correct invoice totals; Indian GST readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Given a line of 1,000 with an 18 percent code of two components, When computed, Then two tax lines of 90 each are created.|Given an expired tax code, When used on a new line, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given rounding, When totals are computed, Then line taxes round to two decimals and the header equals the sum of lines.

title: Units of measure
requirement: Units with code, name, type and conversions (for example 1 box = 12 each) shall be maintained; conversions apply when receipts or invoices use a different unit than the order line.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order in boxes and a receipt in each, When received, Then quantity is converted and compared in the order unit.|Given a unit without conversion to the order unit, When used on a receipt, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a duplicate unit code, When saved, Then it is refused.

title: Payment and shipping terms
requirement: Payment terms (net days, discount percent and days) and shipping terms shall be maintained and defaulted from supplier to order to invoice; invoice due dates and discount dates shall be computed from terms.
acceptance_criteria: Given terms net 30 and an invoice date, When saved, Then the due date is 30 days later.|Given a discount of 2 percent within 10 days, When viewed, Then the discount date and amount are shown.|Given a term deleted while in use, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Masters import, export and ERP sync
requirement: All finance masters shall be importable and exportable through the Foundation import framework and API, with ERP as the optional system of record (inbound sync by schedule) and conflict reporting when a record changed in both systems.
rationale: Every tenant loads masters from an ERP.
acceptance_criteria: Given a chart of accounts file, When imported, Then segments and strings are created and errors reported per row.|Given a record changed in both systems, When synced, Then it is reported as a conflict and not overwritten. (error case)|Given an export, When run, Then files per master are produced.

title: Supplier invitation
requirement: A buyer with the invite permission shall invite a supplier (company name, country, primary contact email or network identifier, optional category and documents to sign), creating a supplier in Invited status in the tenant and a relationship invitation in the Supplier Network, which matches an existing network organisation by tax identifier or email domain or sends a time-limited registration link (72 hours, resendable); duplicates in the tenant shall be flagged before sending.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new company and contact, When invited, Then the supplier exists as Invited and the email is sent.|Given a company that matches an existing supplier by tax identifier or name similarity, When invited, Then a duplicate warning lists the matches and requires confirmation. (error case)|Given an expired link, When resent, Then a new link is sent and the old one stops working.|Given the supplier already exists in the network, When invited, Then the existing organisation receives a connection request instead of a registration link. (edge)

title: Supplier self-registration
requirement: A new supplier shall register once in the Supplier Network (credentials, MFA, terms, network profile: legal name, country, tax identifiers, one contact); an existing supplier shall accept the connection; then the customer-specific wizard with sections enabled per tenant (addresses, contacts, sites, bank accounts, tax and compliance, documents, questionnaires) pre-fills from the network profile, saves progress and submits when mandatory sections are complete.
acceptance_criteria: Given mandatory sections complete, When submitted, Then the supplier moves to Registered and the buyer is notified.|Given a mandatory document missing, When submitted, Then the section and document are named and submission is refused. (error case)|Given progress saved, When the contact returns, Then the wizard resumes where they left.

title: Supplier master
requirement: The supplier master shall hold identity (number auto or manual, legal name, trade name, type, registration type, country), tax identifiers (validated per country rules), classification (categories, commodities, preferred flag, diversity attributes), commercial defaults (currency, payment terms, shipping terms, match levels), portal settings (allowed channels), status fields and custom fields.
acceptance_criteria: Given a supplier with unique identifiers, When saved, Then it is visible to buyers with status.|Given a tax identifier already registered, When saved, Then it is refused naming the field. (error case)|Given India validation on, When a GST or PAN with a wrong format is entered, Then it is refused.

title: Duplicate supplier detection
requirement: On create and on registration the system shall check exact matches (tax identifiers, registration numbers, email, phone, bank account) and fuzzy matches (name and address similarity above a configurable threshold) and show candidates; a buyer may mark a candidate as "not a duplicate" with a reason.
rationale: Duplicate suppliers break spend analysis and payments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a name similar above the threshold, When saved, Then candidates are shown and confirmation required.|Given an exact tax identifier match, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a candidate marked not duplicate, When saved again, Then it is not shown again for that pair.

title: Supplier approval and publishing
requirement: New suppliers shall run the supplier-new approval configuration; approved suppliers shall be published only when publishing criteria are met (mandatory documents valid, required sections complete, at least one active contact, bank account verified when required); unpublishing shall remove the supplier from selection on new documents.
acceptance_criteria: Given criteria met, When published, Then the supplier can be selected on requests and orders.|Given an expired mandatory document, When publishing, Then it is refused naming the document. (error case)|Given unpublished, When a new request line is edited, Then the supplier is not offered and existing documents keep it.

title: Supplier status control
requirement: Permitted users shall put a supplier on hold, release, deactivate and reactivate with a mandatory reason; hold and deactivation shall warn when open orders, receipts in approval or submitted invoices exist and shall require a second confirmation; on hold or inactive suppliers shall not be selectable and their portal users shall see a status notice.
acceptance_criteria: Given open orders, When deactivation is requested, Then the list of open documents is shown and confirmation is required.|Given a supplier on hold, When a buyer creates an order for it, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given reactivation, When done, Then the previous published status is restored.

title: Supplier addresses
requirement: Addresses (type, lines, city, state, country, postal code, one primary, one remit-to) maintained by supplier or buyer, used on orders and invoices.
acceptance_criteria: Given a second address marked primary, When saved, Then the first loses the primary flag.|Given an address used on an open order, When deleted, Then it is refused; it can be deactivated. (error case)|Given a remit-to address, When an invoice is created, Then it defaults to it.

title: Supplier contacts and portal users
requirement: Contacts (name, email unique, phone, role) shall be maintained; a contact with portal access is a Supplier Network user of the supplier organisation (created by the primary contact in the network) and is visible to the tenant as a linked contact; buyers may block a network user for their tenant only; the tenant never holds supplier credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new network user added by the primary contact, When saved, Then the user can act for every customer per role and appears as a contact in each connected tenant.|Given an email already used in the network, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a tenant blocks a network user, When that user opens the tenant's items, Then they are refused for that tenant only and other customers are unaffected.

title: Supplier sites
requirement: Sites (name, address, tax registration, contacts, bank link, status) with site-level approval when configured; orders may target a site; invoices carry the site's tax registration.
acceptance_criteria: Given a site with a tax registration, When an invoice for that site is created, Then the registration is used.|Given a site without mandatory documents when required, When published, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a site deactivated, When a new order is created, Then it is not offered.

title: Supplier bank accounts with verification
requirement: Bank accounts (bank, branch, account number encrypted, codes, currency, primary, attachments) shall be maintained; any addition or change shall run an approval with a mandatory out-of-band verification checklist (call-back to a known number, document check) recorded by the approver; unverified accounts shall not be used for payment instructions; changes shall notify the supplier's primary contact and the buyer owner.
rationale: Bank account change fraud is the main payables risk.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bank change by a supplier user, When submitted, Then the approver sees the checklist and cannot approve until it is completed.|Given a change approved without the checklist, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a change, When saved, Then the primary contact and the buyer owner are notified.

title: Supplier documents and compliance expiry
requirement: Document types (name, issuer type, mandatory for publishing, expiry rule, expiry action: warn, block new orders, unpublish) shall be configured; supplier documents carry issue and expiry dates and attachments; a daily job shall apply expiry actions and notify the supplier and buyer 30, 14 and 1 days before expiry.
acceptance_criteria: Given a document expiring in 14 days, When the job runs, Then supplier and buyer are notified.|Given an expired document with action "block new orders", When an order is created, Then it is refused naming the document. (error case)|Given a renewed document uploaded, When saved, Then the block is lifted.

title: Supplier questionnaires
requirement: Buyers shall send questionnaires (Foundation forms) to suppliers for qualification and periodic review; responses shall be scored by evaluators and stored on the supplier with dates; questionnaires may be required for publishing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a required questionnaire unanswered, When publishing, Then it is refused.|Given a response scored, When viewed on the supplier, Then score and date are shown.|Given a questionnaire sent, When the supplier logs in, Then it appears in their portal with status. (edge)
notes: Foundation forms are a Foundation capability to be added (TF reference: Workflow and Extensibility); listed as a dependency in open questions.

title: Supplier performance indicators
requirement: The system shall compute per supplier and period: on-time acknowledgement rate, on-time delivery rate (receipt date versus need-by), receipt rejection rate, invoice accuracy (invoices held or rejected), and show them on the supplier and in reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given orders and receipts in a quarter, When indicators compute, Then the rates match the underlying documents.|Given no activity, When viewed, Then indicators show "no data" not zero. (edge)|Given an indicator below a threshold, When evaluated, Then the supplier is flagged for review.|Given a user without the supplier performance permission, When indicators are requested, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Supplier change approval
requirement: Changes to approved suppliers (by supplier or buyer) in controlled fields (legal name, tax identifiers, bank, addresses, contacts) shall run the supplier-change approval configuration; uncontrolled fields apply immediately; pending changes shall be visible side by side with current values.
acceptance_criteria: Given a controlled field changed, When saved, Then the record keeps current values until approval and shows the pending change.|Given rejection, When done, Then the change is discarded and the proposer notified.|Given an uncontrolled field changed, When saved, Then it applies at once with history. (edge)|Given a change to a controlled field by a user without permission, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Supplier 360 view and lists
requirement: Buyers shall see a supplier page with tabs (profile, addresses, contacts, sites, banks, documents, questionnaires, performance, orders, receipts, invoices, contracts, catalogue, approvals, history) and lists with filters by status, category, country and document expiry.
acceptance_criteria: Given a supplier, When opened, Then all tabs load with counts.|Given a filter by documents expiring within 30 days, When applied, Then only matching suppliers appear.|Given a user without read permission, When opened, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Supplier configuration defaults
requirement: Tenant administrators shall set defaults for new suppliers (payment terms, currency, match levels, required sections, required documents, portal channels) applied at creation and editable per supplier.
acceptance_criteria: Given defaults set, When a supplier is created, Then fields are pre-filled.|Given a default changed, When existing suppliers are viewed, Then their values are unchanged.|Given a user without the configuration permission, When saving, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Supplier portal ownership
requirement: Every supplier-facing operation shall arrive from the Supplier Network with a delegated token bound to one supplier relationship and shall be bound to that supplier by a Foundation record policy; lists filter to the supplier; access by identifier to another supplier's record is refused and audited with the supplier user identity.
rationale: Gap: missing ownership checks in the current product.
acceptance_criteria: Given supplier A's user requests supplier B's order, When evaluated, Then it is refused and audited. (error case)|Given a list of invoices, When loaded by a supplier user, Then only their invoices appear with correct paging.|Given a buyer impersonating a supplier user, When acting, Then the supplier scope applies and the audit shows both identities.

title: Supplier merge
requirement: A permitted user shall merge a duplicate supplier into a surviving supplier, moving documents, contacts and portal users, with a preview and an audit of the merge; the merged supplier becomes inactive with a pointer to the survivor.
acceptance_criteria: Given a merge preview, When confirmed, Then all documents reference the survivor and the duplicate is inactive.|Given a merge of suppliers with different tax identifiers, When attempted, Then a warning requires confirmation. (edge)|Given a merge, When audited, Then the full list of moved records is recorded.|Given a merge requested by a user without the merge permission, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Supplier categories and preferred status
requirement: Suppliers shall be classified by categories and commodities they serve, with preferred or approved status per category; request and order supplier suggestions shall use these classifications.
rationale: Guide buyers to the right suppliers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a line of category X, When suppliers are suggested, Then preferred suppliers for X appear first.|Given a supplier removed from a category, When suggested, Then it no longer appears for that category.|Given a supplier on hold, When suggested, Then it is excluded. (edge)|Given a category that does not exist, When assigned, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Supplier risk flags
requirement: Buyers shall record risk flags on suppliers (type, severity, source, date, note) that show on supplier selection and may block new orders when severity is critical.
rationale: Manual risk management before any external data source.
acceptance_criteria: Given a critical flag, When an order is created, Then it is refused with the flag shown. (error case)|Given a medium flag, When a supplier is selected, Then a warning is shown.|Given a flag cleared, When saved, Then the history keeps it with the clearing reason.

title: Items
requirement: Items (code auto or manual, name, description, type product or service, unit, category, commodity, tax classification, default price and currency, attributes, images, status) shall be maintained with translations for name and description.
rationale: Standard items for requests and catalogues.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new item with auto code, When saved, Then it receives the next code.|Given an inactive item, When a requester searches, Then it is not offered.|Given a duplicate manual code, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Supplier items
requirement: Supplier items link an item to a supplier with supplier part number, price, currency, unit, lead time, minimum order quantity, availability and validity dates.
acceptance_criteria: Given a supplier item in validity, When a request line picks item and supplier, Then the price is pre-filled.|Given a duplicate item and supplier pair, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given validity ended, When picked, Then the price is not pre-filled and a notice is shown.

title: Catalogue upload and revisions
requirement: Suppliers shall upload catalogues (template download; CSV, spreadsheet or archive with images) creating a revision with lines; validation and duplicate checks run before the revision is submitted; buyers see a diff against the current catalogue (new, changed price, removed).
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid file, When uploaded, Then a revision in Submitted status with a diff exists and the buyer is notified.|Given duplicate part numbers in the file, When uploaded, Then it is refused listing them. (error case)|Given a changed price, When the diff is viewed, Then old and new prices and percent change are shown.

title: Catalogue revision acceptance
requirement: Buyers shall accept or reject a revision (whole or per line, with comments); accepted lines become current catalogue items with validity; rejected lines are reported to the supplier.
acceptance_criteria: Given a revision accepted, When the catalogue is viewed, Then lines reflect it and the supplier is notified.|Given lines rejected with comments, When the supplier views the revision, Then the comments are shown per line.|Given a revision accepted twice, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Catalogue publishing
requirement: Buyers shall publish catalogues with accepted lines to requesters (optionally per organisation unit) and unpublish them; only published lines in validity are orderable.
rationale: Only approved content is bought from.
acceptance_criteria: Given a published catalogue, When a requester browses, Then its lines appear.|Given a catalogue without accepted lines, When published, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a line past validity, When browsed, Then it is hidden.

title: Browse and cart
requirement: Requesters shall browse published catalogue and contract items across suppliers with search, filters (category, supplier, price) and favourites, add to a cart with quantities, and convert the cart into a request with one line per item and supplier pre-filled.
acceptance_criteria: Given items in the cart, When converted, Then a draft request exists with the lines, prices and suppliers.|Given an empty cart, When converted, Then a message says the cart is empty. (error case)|Given a favourite, When the requester returns, Then it is listed first.

title: Contract items in the catalogue
requirement: Published contract items shall appear in browsing with contract price and remaining quantity or value, and lines created from them shall carry the contract reference.
acceptance_criteria: Given a contract item picked, When the request line is created, Then it references the contract and uses its price.|Given a contract expired, When browsed, Then its items are hidden.|Given remaining quantity zero, When picked, Then a notice is shown and the line is created without contract reference. (edge)|Given a contract item of an unpublished contract, When requested by identifier, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Price validity and currency rules
requirement: Catalogue and supplier item prices shall have validity dates and currencies; price changes shall never apply to issued orders; expiring prices shall be reported to buyers 30 days before.
acceptance_criteria: Given a price changed after an order is issued, When the order is viewed, Then its price is unchanged.|Given a price expiring in 30 days, When the job runs, Then the buyer is notified.|Given a price in a currency not allowed for the tenant, When uploaded, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Catalogue search and favourites
requirement: Search shall cover item names, descriptions, part numbers and attributes with synonyms configurable by the tenant; users may keep favourites and recent items.
acceptance_criteria: Given a synonym configured, When searched, Then matching items appear.|Given no results, When searched, Then suggestions by category are shown.|Given recent items, When the catalogue opens, Then they are listed. (edge)|Given a synonym list upload with invalid rows, When imported, Then the rows are reported and skipped. (error case)

title: Catalogue and item imports
requirement: Items and supplier items shall be importable through the Foundation import framework with templates and validation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid item file, When imported, Then items are created and codes allocated.|Given rows with unknown units, When imported, Then they are reported and skipped. (error case)|Given a dry run, When finished, Then nothing is created and the report shows counts.

title: Create and edit a request
requirement: Requesters shall create requests (title, legal entity, currency, chart of account, requested for, organisation unit, project, need-by date, fiscal period, ship-to location, notes, custom fields, attachments) as Draft and edit them in Draft or Rejected; editing in other states is refused.
acceptance_criteria: Given mandatory header fields, When saved, Then a Draft exists without a number.|Given a request in approval, When edited, Then it is refused with the state named. (error case)|Given a rejected request edited and resubmitted, When processed, Then a new approval chain is built.

title: Request lines and lots
requirement: Lines (item or free text, type product or service, quantity or amount basis, quantity, unit, unit price, currency, supplier suggestion, category, need-by, ship-to, custom fields) and lots with child lines, numbered per request, with a duplicate rule on item plus supplier plus account coding plus ship-to.
acceptance_criteria: Given a complete line, When saved, Then it gets the next line number and the request total updates.|Given a duplicate line, When saved, Then it is refused with the duplicate named. (error case)|Given a lot, When child lines are added, Then the lot total equals the sum of children.

title: Account splits on lines
requirement: Each line shall be split across account strings with budget period and percent per the account split rule; a default split from the requester's organisation unit shall be proposed.
acceptance_criteria: Given splits of 60 and 40 percent, When submitted, Then validation passes.|Given splits totalling 90 percent, When submitted, Then "Allocations for line N total 90 percent; they must total 100" is shown. (error case)|Given a default split configured, When a line is created, Then it is pre-filled and editable.

title: Line currencies and conversion
requirement: When multi-currency lines are allowed, lines may be in allowed currencies and are converted to the header currency with the rate valid on the request date; the request shows both amounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a line in USD and header in INR, When saved, Then the converted amount uses the valid rate.|Given no rate, When saved, Then it is refused naming the pair and date. (error case)|Given multi-currency off, When editing, Then only the header currency is offered.

title: Submission validations
requirement: On submit the system shall validate header mandatory fields, at least one line, mandatory line fields, splits totalling 100 percent, supplier status (published, not on hold, no critical flag, no blocking expired document), item status, budget period open, and run hook points; it shall then allocate the number and start the approval chain (or approve directly when no configuration applies).
acceptance_criteria: Given a complete request, When submitted, Then it is numbered and In Approval (or Approved).|Given a supplier on hold on a line, When submitted, Then it is refused naming the line and supplier. (error case)|Given a hook that blocks, When submitted, Then the message is shown and the request stays Draft.

title: Budget check at submission
requirement: Submission shall apply the budget availability check with reservation (FF-006) when request budget validation is on, blocking or warning as configured, and show approvers the budget status per split.
acceptance_criteria: Given blocking on and budget short, When submitted, Then it is refused with the shortfall per account string.|Given warning on, When submitted, Then it proceeds and the approval screen shows the shortfall.|Given validation off, When submitted, Then no budget check runs and no reservation is made. (edge)

title: Approval of requests
requirement: Requests shall use the Foundation workflow with the request document type, conditions on header, line and split fields (amount, category, legal entity, supplier, account string, custom fields), dynamic approvers (manager chain, budget owner, account string owner, category group) and the standard actions; approvers shall see lines, splits, budget status and attachments in the approval view.
acceptance_criteria: Given a configuration on amount above 10,000 with manager chain, When submitted, Then the requester's manager is an approver.|Given a rejection, When done, Then the requester is notified and may edit.|Given an approver who is also the requester and self-approval is disallowed, When they try, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Cancel a request
requirement: The requester or a permitted user shall cancel a request in Draft, In Approval or Approved without orders, with a reason, releasing budget reservations and notifying pending approvers.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Approved request without orders, When cancelled, Then it is Cancelled and reservations released.|Given a request with an order, When cancelled, Then it is refused; close-short is offered instead. (error case)|Given cancellation, When audited, Then the reason is recorded.

title: Convert a request to orders
requirement: A buyer shall convert an Approved request into one draft order per supplier (default) with the option to split or merge lines across orders before submission; lines without supplier must be assigned a supplier first; converted lines are linked and the request becomes Partially Ordered or Ordered.
acceptance_criteria: Given approved lines for two suppliers, When converted, Then two draft orders exist and the request is Ordered.|Given a line without supplier, When converted, Then it is refused naming the line. (error case)|Given only some lines converted, When saved, Then the request is Partially Ordered with remaining quantities visible.

title: Partial ordering and close-short
requirement: Remaining quantities on request lines shall be orderable later; a buyer or requester shall close a request or line short with a reason, releasing remaining budget reservation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a line of 10 with 6 ordered, When viewed, Then 4 remains orderable.|Given close-short, When applied, Then the remaining 4 is released and the line is Closed.|Given a closed line, When conversion is attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Copy and templates
requirement: Users shall copy a request into a new draft and save requests as personal or shared templates; templates pre-fill header and lines without numbers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a copy, When created, Then lines and splits are copied as a new Draft.|Given a template used, When created, Then the request is Draft with template lines.|Given a template with an inactive item, When used, Then the line is flagged for review. (edge)|Given a template shared by a user without the share permission, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Request lists and visibility
requirement: Lists of requests with filters (status, requester, unit, period, supplier, amount) shall respect visibility: requesters see their own and those requested for them, buyers see their units, approvers see those they act on, administrators see all.
acceptance_criteria: Given a requester, When listing, Then only their requests appear.|Given a buyer scoped to unit A, When listing, Then requests of unit A and children appear.|Given a user without any request permission, When opening, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Ship-to locations
requirement: Ship-to locations per legal entity or unit with addresses shall be offered on lines and carried to orders.
acceptance_criteria: Given locations for the unit, When a line is edited, Then they are offered.|Given a location of another legal entity, When saved on the line, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a location on the line, When the order is created, Then the order line carries it.

title: Request totals and summary
requirement: Requests shall show line totals, converted totals in header currency, tax estimate when codes are set, budget status per split, linked orders and a summary panel for approvers.
acceptance_criteria: Given lines in two currencies, When viewed, Then the total is in header currency with the rates used.|Given linked orders, When viewed, Then order numbers and statuses are listed.|Given no rate for a line, When totals compute, Then the total shows as unavailable with the reason instead of a wrong number. (error case)

title: Create orders
requirement: Orders shall be created from requests (FF-058) or directly by buyers with the permission (header: supplier and site, legal entity, chart of account, currency, delivery and billing addresses, payment and shipping terms, delivery channel, template, contact; lines: item, quantity, unit, price, tax code, ship-to, need-by, contract reference, splits), as Draft with the number allocated at submission.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order created from a request, When viewed, Then each line links to its request line and splits are copied.|Given a supplier not published, When an order is created, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a direct order, When created, Then the buyer must have the direct-order permission.

title: Order lines and totals
requirement: Order lines carry quantity or amount basis, unit price, discounts, tax lines from tax codes, charges (freight, handling) at header or line, and compute totals in order currency with converted amounts in legal entity currency.
acceptance_criteria: Given lines, taxes and charges, When totals compute, Then the total equals lines plus taxes plus charges minus discounts.|Given a tax code expired, When used, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a change in a line, When saved, Then totals recompute.

title: Order splits and budget
requirement: Order lines inherit splits from request lines or require splits for direct orders with the same rules; budget reservation moves from request to order without double counting; direct orders reserve budget at submission when configured.
acceptance_criteria: Given a converted line, When viewed, Then splits equal the request line's splits.|Given a direct order with splits short of 100 percent, When submitted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a direct order submitted with validation on, When processed, Then budget is reserved.

title: Order submission and approval
requirement: Submission shall validate header and lines, supplier status and documents, contract limits, and run the order approval configuration (new and change types) when configured; otherwise the order is Approved.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order above a threshold with a configuration, When submitted, Then it is In Approval with the configured approvers.|Given a supplier with a blocking expired document, When submitted, Then it is refused naming the document. (error case)|Given no configuration, When submitted, Then it is Approved.

title: Match level and tolerance stamping
requirement: On approval each line shall be stamped with the resolved match level (supplier value for the line type, else chart of account, else system default) and the over-receipt and invoice tolerances in force; stamps never change; later configuration changes affect new orders only.
acceptance_criteria: Given supplier 2-way and chart 3-way for products, When approved, Then product lines are stamped 2-way.|Given a stamped line, When the supplier's match level changes, Then the line keeps its stamp.|Given a line with match level None, When stamped, Then no quantity tracking applies to it. (edge)|Given a stamping attempt on a line that is not approved, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Issue orders by channel
requirement: Approved orders shall be issued through the chosen channel: email with the rendered PDF, supplier portal notification, or internal only; the rendered document uses the legal entity's template; issue sets Issued, records time and channel, and stores the PDF.
acceptance_criteria: Given channel email, When issued, Then the supplier contact receives the PDF and the order is Issued.|Given no template, When issued, Then it is refused naming the missing template. (error case)|Given channel portal, When issued, Then the supplier sees it with an acknowledge action.

title: Supplier acknowledgement
requirement: Supplier users shall acknowledge an issued order by accepting, declining with reason, or proposing changes (dates, quantities, prices per line) within a configurable period; the buyer is notified; proposals are accepted as a change order or rejected; on-time acknowledgement is measured.
acceptance_criteria: Given acceptance, When saved, Then status is Acknowledged and the buyer notified.|Given a proposal, When the buyer accepts it, Then a change order version is created with the proposed values and re-issued.|Given a declined order, When the supplier later tries to accept, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Acknowledgement reminders
requirement: Unacknowledged orders shall trigger reminders to the supplier after configurable days and escalation to the buyer; the order list shall flag overdue acknowledgements.
acceptance_criteria: Given 3 days without acknowledgement, When the job runs, Then the supplier is reminded and the order flagged.|Given acknowledgement received, When evaluated, Then no further reminder is sent.|Given 7 days, When the job runs, Then the buyer is notified. (edge)|Given reminder days set to zero or negative, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Order lists and views
requirement: Order lists with filters and saved views; order line view across orders with ordered, received, invoiced and open quantities; service orders view; supplier-specific list in the portal.
acceptance_criteria: Given the line view, When loaded, Then each line shows the four quantities.|Given a supplier user, When listing, Then only their orders appear.|Given a user without read permission, When opening, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Change orders with versions
requirement: Buyers shall change issued orders by creating a new version (lines added, changed or cancelled; header changes), with a change summary, re-approval per configuration, and re-issue; quantities cannot be reduced below received or invoiced; prices cannot change for fully invoiced lines; previous versions remain viewable and the supplier sees the diff.
rationale: Gap: current product sets the order back to draft without versions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a quantity reduced below received, When saved, Then it is refused naming the line. (error case)|Given a change approved and issued, When the supplier opens it, Then version 2 with the diff and a new acknowledgement request is shown.|Given version history, When viewed, Then each version shows who, when and what changed.

title: Hold and release
requirement: Buyers shall put an order on hold with reason (no receipts or invoices accepted) and release it; suppliers see the hold notice.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order on hold, When a receipt is created, Then it is refused with the hold reason. (error case)|Given release, When done, Then receipts and invoices are accepted again.|Given hold, When the supplier views the order, Then the notice is shown.

title: Soft close, close and cancel
requirement: Soft close stops receipts and allows invoices; close requires all lines closed for receiving and invoicing (or close-short); cancel is allowed only without approved receipts or submitted invoices; each with reason, budget release of remaining reservation, and supplier notification.
acceptance_criteria: Given approved receipts, When cancel is attempted, Then it is refused; soft close is offered. (error case)|Given soft close, When an invoice is created, Then it is allowed and a receipt is refused.|Given close, When done, Then remaining reservations are released.

title: Line closure flags and close-short
requirement: Each order line shall have closed-for-receiving and closed-for-invoicing flags set automatically when quantities are met within tolerance, or manually by close-short with reason; closed lines refuse the related documents and release remaining budget.
rationale: Standard practice (final delivery and final invoice indicators).
acceptance_criteria: Given a line fully received within tolerance, When the receipt is approved, Then closed-for-receiving is set automatically.|Given a line closed for invoicing, When an invoice line references it, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given close-short, When applied, Then both flags are set and the budget remainder released.

title: Contract reference on order lines
requirement: Order lines may reference a contract item; price is taken from the contract; released quantity and value accumulate on the contract at issue and are released on cancellation; exceeding the contract limit is blocked or warned per setting.
acceptance_criteria: Given a contract line with 100 remaining, When an order line of 60 is issued, Then remaining shows 40.|Given an order line of 150 against 100 remaining with blocking on, When submitted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given the order cancelled, When processed, Then remaining returns to 100.

title: Order totals, taxes and documents
requirement: Orders shall show totals by currency, tax breakdown by code and component, charges, and the rendered PDF per version; printing uses the template with tenant branding.
acceptance_criteria: Given taxes with two components, When viewed, Then the breakdown shows both.|Given version 2 issued, When the PDF list is viewed, Then both versions' PDFs exist.|Given a missing tax code on a taxable line, When submitted, Then a warning asks for confirmation. (edge)|Given a tax component total that does not equal the header tax, When computed, Then the document is refused as inconsistent. (error case)

title: Requester confirmation and notifications
requirement: Requesters shall be notified when their lines are ordered, issued, acknowledged, received and invoiced; they may confirm receipt for desk deliveries when configured (creating a receipt in their name).
rationale: Close the loop with the requester.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order issued for the requester's line, When processed, Then the requester is notified with the order number.|Given desk-delivery confirmation enabled, When the requester confirms, Then a receipt is created and routed per configuration.|Given confirmation disabled, When the requester views the order, Then no confirm action appears. (edge)|Given a requester confirming receipt for a line not theirs, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Blanket and standing orders
requirement: Blanket orders with a value or quantity ceiling and validity, against which release orders are created without approval up to the ceiling. Recorded for a later slice.
rationale: Common for services and recurring supplies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a blanket order, When a release is created within the ceiling, Then it is issued without approval when configured.|Given a release above the ceiling, When submitted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given validity ended, When a release is created, Then it is refused.

title: Shipment notices (ASN)
requirement: Supplier users shall create shipment notices against issued or acknowledged order lines (quantities not above open quantity, ship date, expected date, carrier, tracking, packages, attachments), save and submit; buyers shall approve or reject when approval is configured; approved notices are shown when creating receipts.
acceptance_criteria: Given open lines, When a notice is submitted, Then the buyer is notified and the notice is In Approval or Approved per configuration.|Given a quantity above open quantity, When submitted, Then it is refused naming the line. (error case)|Given an approved notice, When a receipt is created, Then its lines are offered with announced quantities.

title: Shipment notice visibility and tracking
requirement: Buyers and receivers shall see notices per order and per expected date, with status; a notice may be marked received in full or partially by the receipts created from it.
acceptance_criteria: Given notices expected this week, When filtered, Then they are listed by date.|Given receipts created from a notice, When viewed, Then the notice shows received versus announced per line.|Given a notice cancelled by the supplier before receipt, When viewed, Then it is marked cancelled. (edge)|Given a notice marked received by a user without the receiving permission, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Create a receipt
requirement: Receivers shall create receipts against order lines (optionally from a notice) with received quantity and unit, warehouse, inspection result (accepted, rejected, damaged with quantities), received date, delivery note number, notes and attachments; the pending quantity shall be computed under row locks as ordered × (1 + tolerance) − receipts submitted − receipts approved, and a receipt above it shall be refused.
rationale: Gap: non-atomic check in the current product.
acceptance_criteria: Given two receipts created at once for the last 5 units, When processed, Then exactly one succeeds.|Given quantity above pending, When saved, Then "Quantity exceeds the open quantity of N" is shown. (error case)|Given a receipt in boxes for an order in each, When saved, Then the quantity is converted.

title: Receipt tolerance
requirement: Receipts shall respect the over-receipt tolerance stamped on the order line (else the legal entity or system tolerance) by percentage or value; receipts beyond tolerance are refused; receipts below quantity are allowed (partial deliveries).
acceptance_criteria: Given tolerance 5 percent and ordered 100, When 105 is received cumulatively, Then it is accepted; 106 is refused.|Given tolerance zero, When 101 is received, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a partial receipt, When saved, Then the remaining quantity is shown.

title: Inspection and warehouse
requirement: Inspection results per line (accepted, rejected, damaged quantities with reasons and photos) and warehouse or location shall be recorded; only accepted quantity counts as received for invoicing when the inspection setting is on; rejected quantities create a return proposal.
acceptance_criteria: Given 10 received with 2 rejected and the setting on, When approved, Then 8 counts for invoicing and a return proposal for 2 exists.|Given rejected quantity without reason, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given the setting off, When approved, Then the full received quantity counts.

title: Receipt submission and approval
requirement: Submission shall re-run the pending and tolerance checks, then route through the receipt approval configuration when receipt approval is required (a tenant-wide switch in version 1, with the setting model prepared for per-organisation, per-supplier and per-category control later), else approve directly; approved receipt lines become invoiceable for 3-way lines and update buckets.
acceptance_criteria: Given approval required, When submitted, Then approvers see it with lines and inspection.|Given approval not required, When submitted, Then it is Approved at once and buckets update.|Given approval, When done, Then the receipt date and approver are recorded. (edge)|Given a submitted receipt approved by the receiver who created it when self-approval is disallowed, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Receipt rejection and cancellation
requirement: Rejection by an approver releases the receipt quantity; cancellation of an approved receipt requires the permission, a reason, and is refused when any quantity has been invoiced (credit note path instead); both notify the receiver.
acceptance_criteria: Given an approved receipt partly invoiced, When cancel is attempted, Then it is refused naming the invoice. (error case)|Given rejection, When done, Then the pending quantity increases accordingly.|Given cancellation, When done, Then received approved decreases and the audit shows the reason.

title: Returns to supplier
requirement: A return document shall reference approved receipt lines with return quantity and reason, run approval when configured, reduce received approved quantity on approval, be refused for quantities already invoiced (credit note required first), and notify the supplier with a return note PDF.
rationale: Standard practice; absent in the current product.
acceptance_criteria: Given 10 received approved and 0 invoiced, When a return of 3 is approved, Then received approved is 7 and open to receive increases by 3.|Given 10 received with 10 invoiced, When a return is attempted, Then it is refused with the credit note path explained. (error case)|Given approval, When done, Then the supplier receives the return note.

title: Received and invoiced buckets
requirement: Order lines shall carry received submitted, received approved, invoiced submitted and invoiced approved; receipt lines shall carry invoiced submitted and invoiced approved; every transition shall update buckets in the same transaction under row locks (submit adds to submitted, approve moves to approved, reject releases submitted, cancel and return release approved, credit note reverses approved).
rationale: The system of record for matching.
acceptance_criteria: Given a receipt approved for 6 of 10, When viewed, Then received approved is 6 and open to receive is 4 (tolerance zero).|Given an invoice submitted for 6 against a 2-way line, When viewed, Then invoiced submitted is 6 and open to invoice is 4.|Given a transition that would make a bucket negative, When attempted, Then it is refused as an integrity error. (error case)

title: Open quantities view
requirement: Buyers, receivers and payables shall see per order line the open-to-receive and open-to-invoice quantities and amounts, computed from buckets, with drill-down to the documents.
acceptance_criteria: Given buckets, When the view loads, Then open quantities match the formulas in section 7.1.|Given a drill-down, When clicked, Then the receipts and invoices of the line are listed.|Given a line with match level None, When viewed, Then quantities show as not tracked. (edge)|Given a user without read permission on orders, When the view is requested, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Warehouses and locations
requirement: Warehouses and locations per legal entity (code, name, address, active) shall be maintained in a screen and offered on receipts.
rationale: Gap: no screen in the current product.
acceptance_criteria: Given a warehouse created, When a receipt is made, Then it is offered.|Given a duplicate code, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a warehouse deactivated, When used on a new receipt, Then it is not offered.

title: Receipt documents and print
requirement: Receipts shall render as PDF with the legal entity template (goods receipt note) and be downloadable by buyers and the supplier.
acceptance_criteria: Given a template, When rendered, Then the PDF shows lines, quantities and inspection.|Given no template, When rendered, Then it is refused naming the template. (error case)|Given the supplier user, When they open their receipt, Then the same PDF is available.

title: Service receipts
requirement: For service lines on amount basis, receipts shall record amount received (service entry) instead of quantity, with the same pending and tolerance logic on amounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a service line of 10,000 and a service receipt of 6,000, When saved, Then open to receive is 4,000.|Given a service receipt above open amount plus tolerance, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given invoicing of the service line, When submitted, Then capacity uses received amounts for 3-way.

title: Receiving delegation and requester receipts
requirement: Receiving duties shall be delegable (Foundation delegation type receiving); requesters may be allowed to confirm receipt for their own lines per configuration, creating receipts routed per the receipt approval setting.
acceptance_criteria: Given a delegation to user B, When B records a receipt for A's unit, Then it is allowed and attributed to both.|Given requester confirmation enabled, When the requester confirms, Then a receipt exists in their name.|Given requester confirmation disabled, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Receipt lists and supplier view
requirement: Receipt lists (all, per order, per supplier, pending approval) for buyers and receivers; suppliers see their receipts in the portal with quantities and inspection results.
acceptance_criteria: Given a supplier user, When listing, Then only their receipts appear.|Given filters by pending approval, When applied, Then only those appear.|Given a user without read permission, When opening, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Invoice types
requirement: The system shall support order-based invoices (lines from order lines stamped 2-way or from approved receipt lines for 3-way), non-order invoices (coded lines), proforma invoices (referencing an order, consuming nothing) and credit notes (referencing an approved invoice); type decides creation path, validations and effects.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order with 2-way and 3-way lines, When an invoice is created from it, Then 2-way lines take order quantities and 3-way lines offer approved receipt lines.|Given a credit note without reference, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a proforma, When approved, Then no bucket or budget changes.

title: Create invoice from orders
requirement: AP users and supplier users shall create an invoice from one or more orders of the same supplier with open 2-way lines (eligibility check), copying lines with open quantities and prices, allowing partial quantities, and appending further orders to a draft invoice of the same supplier.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order with open lines, When an invoice is created, Then a draft with those lines exists and the order is linked.|Given all lines invoiced, When created, Then "All lines of this order are already invoiced" is shown. (error case)|Given a draft of another supplier, When appending, Then it is refused.

title: Create invoice from receipts
requirement: For 3-way lines, invoices shall be built from approved receipt lines with open quantity, one invoice line per order line fed by one or more receipt lines (allocations summing to the line quantity), with the source picker showing pending-approval receipts as not yet billable.
acceptance_criteria: Given two approved receipts of 5 for one order line, When an invoice line of 10 is created, Then two source rows of 5 exist.|Given a receipt line in approval, When selected, Then it is shown as pending and cannot be used. (error case)|Given an allocation sum different from the line quantity, When saved, Then it is refused.

title: Non-order invoices
requirement: Non-order invoices shall require supplier, legal entity, chart of account, currency, supplier invoice number and date, and lines with description, amount, tax code and account splits totalling 100 percent; routing uses the invoice approval configuration; budget check applies when configured.
acceptance_criteria: Given complete coding, When submitted, Then it is Submitted and routed.|Given a line without splits, When submitted, Then it is refused naming the line. (error case)|Given the tenant policy "orders required" or a supplier flagged "orders required", When a non-order invoice is created, Then it is refused or warned per the tenant or supplier setting (the supplier setting overrides the tenant setting).
notes: Decision F-06 confirmed: policy at tenant and supplier level.

title: Proforma invoices
requirement: Proforma invoices reference an order, carry amounts for advance payment, follow approval, and never consume order quantities or budget; later final invoices may reference the proforma for netting (advance applied).
acceptance_criteria: Given a proforma approved, When the final invoice is created, Then the advance can be applied and the payable amount reduced.|Given a proforma without order, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a proforma, When buckets are viewed, Then nothing changed.

title: Invoice lines, taxes, charges, discounts and withholding
requirement: Lines (item or description, quantity, unit, unit price, tax code, account splits where needed), taxes at header or line level (one or the other), charges (freight, handling, other) at header or line, discounts and withholding at header or line, with totals computed and rounded per currency; the supplier's totals as printed shall be entered and compared to computed totals with a tolerance.
acceptance_criteria: Given header taxes switched to line level, When saved, Then header tax lines are removed and line taxes required.|Given the entered total differs from the computed total beyond tolerance, When submitted, Then a warning or block applies per setting. (error case)|Given rounding, When totals compute, Then header equals the sum of rounded lines.

title: Account coding for invoice lines
requirement: Order-based lines inherit splits from order lines (editable only with permission); non-order lines require splits; a single chart of account per invoice is enforced when the setting is on.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order-based line, When viewed, Then splits equal the order line's splits.|Given the single-chart setting on and lines of two charts, When submitted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a user with the override permission, When splits are changed on an order-based line, Then the change is audited.

title: Capacity checks at submission
requirement: On submission, for each order-based line the system shall lock the order line and source receipt lines in a fixed order and check: 2-way quantity ≤ open to invoice on the order line; 3-way allocations ≤ open on each receipt line and receipt lines approved; strict-invoice-once setting blocks any prior consumption; closed-for-invoicing lines refused; then update invoiced submitted buckets.
acceptance_criteria: Given open 4 and an invoice of 4, When submitted, Then it passes and open becomes 0; an invoice of 5 is refused naming the line.|Given two invoices for the same last units submitted at once, When processed, Then exactly one succeeds.|Given strict mode and a line with any prior invoice, When submitted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Variance tolerances and holds
requirement: Submission shall check unit price, quantity, line amount and total amount variances against the stamped or configured tolerances (percentage or value); per tolerance type the action is block (refuse) or hold (submit with a hold reason that must be released by a permitted user before approval completes); holds are listed in a holds console.
acceptance_criteria: Given price variance 3 percent with tolerance 2 percent and action hold, When submitted, Then the invoice is Submitted with a price hold and approval cannot complete until release.|Given action block, When submitted, Then it is refused naming the line and variance. (error case)|Given a hold released with reason, When approval completes, Then the release is in the audit.

title: Duplicate invoice check
requirement: No two live invoices (not cancelled or rejected) of the same supplier may share the supplier invoice number; a fuzzy check (same supplier, same amount, date within 7 days) shall warn.
rationale: Gap in the current product; standard control.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing live invoice with number X for supplier S, When another with X is submitted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given the earlier invoice is Cancelled, When submitted, Then it is allowed.|Given same amount within 7 days, When submitted, Then a warning asks for confirmation.

title: Stale match level and refresh
requirement: A draft invoice shall snapshot the match level of each order line; at submission a mismatch with the current stamp (possible only for lines approved later) refuses submission and the draft can be refreshed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stale snapshot, When submitted, Then it is refused with "Order line N changed; refresh the draft". (error case)|Given refresh, When done, Then the snapshot updates and lines are re-validated.|Given no change, When submitted, Then no refresh is needed.

title: Budget check for non-order invoices
requirement: Non-order invoices shall apply the budget check with reservation when invoice budget validation is on; order-based invoices do not consume again.
acceptance_criteria: Given validation on and short budget with blocking, When submitted, Then it is refused with the shortfall.|Given an order-based invoice, When submitted, Then no new reservation is made. (edge)|Given validation off, When submitted, Then no check runs.

title: Invoice approval and disputes
requirement: Invoices shall run the invoice approval configuration with conditions (amount, supplier, variance flags, non-order flag, hold flags); approvers see lines, matched documents, variances and holds; a permitted user may mark an invoice Disputed with reason and resolve it back to Submitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invoice with a hold, When all approvers approve, Then status remains pending until the hold is released. (edge)|Given a dispute, When marked, Then the supplier is notified with the reason.|Given rejection, When done, Then the invoice returns to Draft with the reason and buckets release submitted quantities.|Given a dispute marked by a user without the permission, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Cancel an invoice
requirement: Cancellation with reason shall be allowed in Draft, Submitted and Approved before payment release, releasing invoiced buckets and budget; after payment release only credit notes apply.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Approved invoice not released, When cancelled, Then buckets and budget are released.|Given an invoice released for payment, When cancel is attempted, Then it is refused with the credit note path. (error case)|Given cancellation, When audited, Then the reason is recorded.

title: Payment release and payment status
requirement: Approved invoices shall be released for payment by a permitted user (manual or automatic per setting) moving to Approved For Payment with a payment run reference; payment status (paid, partially paid, date, reference, amount) shall be received from the ERP through the API and shown on the invoice; fully paid invoices become Paid.
acceptance_criteria: Given release, When done, Then status is Approved For Payment and the event is published for the ERP.|Given a payment status for an unknown invoice, When received, Then it is rejected with an error. (error case)|Given partial payment, When received, Then status is Partially Paid with the paid amount.

title: Payment terms, due dates and discounts
requirement: Invoices shall carry payment terms (from supplier or order), compute due date and early-payment discount date and amount, and lists shall flag invoices due within 7 days or overdue.
acceptance_criteria: Given net 30, When the invoice date is set, Then the due date is 30 days later.|Given a discount term, When viewed, Then the discount date and amount are shown.|Given an overdue unpaid invoice, When listed, Then it is flagged. (edge)|Given payment terms missing on the supplier and the order, When an invoice is submitted, Then it is refused until terms are set. (error case)

title: Invoice lists, queue and summaries
requirement: Lists (all, per order, per supplier, drafts, held, disputed, due) with saved views; an AP work queue of invoices needing action by age; summaries per invoice (totals, taxes, matched documents) and global (counts and amounts by status).
acceptance_criteria: Given invoices in several states, When the queue loads, Then items needing action appear with age and reason.|Given a supplier user, When listing, Then only their invoices appear.|Given global summary, When viewed, Then counts match the lists. (edge)|Given a user without invoice read permission, When the queue is opened, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Credit notes
requirement: Credit notes shall reference an approved or paid invoice (whole or lines), carry the supplier's credit note number (unique per supplier), run approval, and on approval reverse invoiced approved buckets and budget consumption as negative movement and publish an event for the ERP; source rows are never deleted.
rationale: Gap in the current product; required for returns and disputes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a credit note for 3 units of an invoiced line, When approved, Then invoiced approved decreases by 3 and the receipt line shows 3 open again.|Given a credit note above the invoiced quantity, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given approval, When done, Then an event is published with the reference to the original invoice.

title: Invoice attachments and capture suggestions
requirement: Invoices shall store the supplier's PDF or image; when the AI capture feature is enabled, the AI service shall propose header and line values from the document as suggestions with confidence; the user confirms before any value is saved; suggestions and confirmations are audited.
acceptance_criteria: Given a PDF uploaded and capture enabled, When processed, Then suggestions appear marked as suggested with confidence.|Given the user confirms, When saved, Then the confirmed values are stored and the audit shows suggestion and confirmation.|Given the AI service unavailable, When processed, Then the user is told and enters values manually. (error case)

title: E-invoicing readiness
requirement: Invoice headers shall hold the fields needed for statutory e-invoices (for example registration numbers, place of supply, invoice reference number, QR code text, document type codes) as configurable fields per country, validated when the country rule is on.
rationale: Indian GST e-invoice and similar regimes; the Indian rules themselves arrive as an accelerator pack (FF-176).
acceptance_criteria: Given the India rule on and a missing invoice reference number on a B2B invoice above the threshold, When submitted, Then a warning or block applies per setting.|Given the rule off, When submitted, Then no e-invoice validation runs.|Given the fields present, When exported to the ERP, Then they are included. (edge)|Given an e-invoice field with an invalid format, When submitted with the rule on, Then it is refused naming the field. (error case)

title: Accrual report
requirement: A received-not-invoiced report per legal entity, period and account string shall compute (received approved − invoiced approved) × order price per line, excluding receipts pending approval, exportable and reconcilable to buckets.
acceptance_criteria: Given received approved 10 and invoiced approved 6 at price 100, When the report runs, Then the line shows 400.|Given a receipt in approval, When the report runs, Then it is excluded.|Given export, When run, Then the file totals match the screen. (edge)|Given a user without the accrual report permission, When run, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Uninvoiced and open-order views
requirement: Views of orders and lines not fully invoiced and not fully received, with ages and supplier, to drive follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: Given lines open to invoice, When the view loads, Then they are listed with open quantity and value.|Given a line closed for invoicing, When the view loads, Then it is excluded.|Given a filter by supplier, When applied, Then only that supplier's lines appear. (edge)|Given a user without order read permission, When the view is requested, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Matching configuration
requirement: Tenant settings shall define default match levels, receipt approval required, strict invoice-once, single chart per invoice, tolerance values and actions per type, duplicate fuzzy window, non-order invoice policy (tenant level, overridable per supplier), payment release mode and e-invoice rules; each setting shall be overridable per organisation where section 2.2 allows.
acceptance_criteria: Given strict invoice-once switched on, When the next invoice is submitted, Then the strict rule applies.|Given a tolerance set to a negative value, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a setting changed, When 60 seconds pass, Then it applies without restart.

title: Nightly reconciliation of buckets and budgets
requirement: A nightly job shall recompute received and invoiced buckets from receipts and invoices and budget reserved and consumed from documents, compare with stored values, write differences to a drift report and alert operators; drift is an incident, not auto-healed.
rationale: Counters are a cache; documents are the truth.
acceptance_criteria: Given consistent data, When the job runs, Then zero drift rows exist and a success record is stored.|Given a manual database change that breaks a counter, When the job runs, Then the drift row names the line and values and an alert fires. (error case)|Given the job fails, When detected, Then an alert fires.

title: Holds console
requirement: A console lists invoices on hold with reason, age, owner and release action requiring a reason; releasing is permission-controlled and audited.
acceptance_criteria: Given held invoices, When the console loads, Then they are listed by age.|Given release by a user without the permission, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given release, When done, Then approval can complete and the audit shows the reason.

title: Contract repository
requirement: Contracts (number, name, type, supplier, legal entities covered, currency, start, end, value ceiling, owner, renewal terms, documents and clauses as attachments, custom fields) shall be maintained with approval (new and change) and publishing.
acceptance_criteria: Given mandatory fields, When saved, Then the contract is Draft with a number at submission.|Given an end date before start, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given publishing, When done, Then items become orderable.

title: Contract items and pricing
requirement: Contract items (item or description, unit, price, currency, validity, quantity or value ceiling per item) with price tiers by quantity and validity.
acceptance_criteria: Given tiers 1 to 99 at 10 and 100 plus at 9, When a line of 150 is created, Then price 9 applies.|Given a duplicate item in a contract, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given validity ended, When picked, Then the item is not offered.

title: Contract approval and publishing
requirement: New contracts and changes run the contract approval configurations; only published contracts are offered; unpublishing hides items but keeps references on existing orders.
acceptance_criteria: Given approval, When published, Then items appear in browsing.|Given a contract unpublished, When an existing order is viewed, Then its reference remains.|Given a change to a published contract, When saved, Then it runs the change approval and the published version stays until approval. (edge)|Given publishing attempted before approval, When requested, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Contract consumption
requirement: Released quantity and value accumulate from issued order lines referencing the contract and release on cancellation or close-short; thresholds (for example 80 percent) alert the owner; exceeding the ceiling blocks or warns per setting.
rationale: Know when a contract runs out.
acceptance_criteria: Given 80 percent reached, When the next order is issued, Then the owner is alerted.|Given 100 percent reached with blocking, When an order is submitted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given an order cancelled, When processed, Then the consumption is released.

title: Expiry and renewal alerts
requirement: Contracts expiring within 90, 60 and 30 days shall alert owners; a renewal creates a new version with new dates and optional price changes while keeping history.
acceptance_criteria: Given 60 days to expiry, When the job runs, Then the owner is notified.|Given a renewal, When saved, Then a new version exists and the old one is read-only.|Given an expired contract, When items are browsed, Then they are hidden. (edge)|Given a renewal with an end date before the new start date, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Contract documents and clauses
requirement: Contracts hold documents (signed copies, amendments) and key clause fields (liability cap, payment terms, termination notice) as structured attributes for reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Given clause fields, When filtered in the list, Then matching contracts appear.|Given a signed copy uploaded, When viewed, Then it is listed with version.|Given a document deleted, When attempted on a published contract, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Contract reports
requirement: Reports on contract coverage (spend on contract versus off contract per category), consumption, expiry calendar and supplier contract list.
acceptance_criteria: Given orders with and without contract references, When the coverage report runs, Then on-contract percent is shown per category.|Given export, When run, Then a file is produced.|Given no contracts, When run, Then an empty state is shown. (edge)|Given a user without the contract report permission, When run, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Contract import
requirement: Contracts and items importable through the import framework.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid file, When imported, Then contracts and items exist as Draft.|Given an unknown supplier, When imported, Then the row is reported. (error case)|Given a dry run, When finished, Then nothing is created.

title: Supplier portal access through the network
