requirement: Supplier users log in once to the Supplier Network (password, MFA; SSO later), see a customer switcher and a unified inbox, and open each customer's screens served with that customer's name, branding context, organisation and rules; inside a customer they see only their supplier's records (FF-036) and only modules the customer enabled for suppliers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a supplier user connected to two customers, When logged in, Then the inbox shows both customers' items and the switcher lists both.|Given an enterprise user, When they open the network portal, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given customer A disables supplier invoicing, When the supplier works in A, Then invoices are hidden for A only.

title: Orders and acknowledgement in the portal
requirement: Suppliers see issued orders and versions with PDFs, acknowledge (FF-076), and see holds, soft closes and cancellations.
acceptance_criteria: Given an issued order, When opened, Then the PDF and the acknowledge actions are shown.|Given version 2, When opened, Then the diff and a new acknowledgement request are shown.|Given an order of another supplier by identifier, When requested, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Shipment notices in the portal
requirement: Suppliers create and submit shipment notices (FF-090) from their orders and see their status.
acceptance_criteria: Given open lines, When a notice is submitted, Then it appears in the buyer's list.|Given a notice rejected, When viewed, Then the reason is shown.|Given a cancelled order, When a notice is attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Company data in the portal
requirement: The primary contact maintains one company profile in the network (company data, addresses, contacts, bank accounts, documents) and customer-specific data (sites, questionnaires, customer-required documents) per customer; profile changes are offered to every connected customer and each applies its approval and verification rules; a per-customer pending indicator shows what awaits approval and what was declined.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bank change in the network profile, When submitted, Then every connected customer shows a pending change with its own verification checklist.|Given a non-primary contact, When they try to change bank data, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a document expiring for customer A, When the supplier logs in, Then a reminder names customer A.

title: Receipts and returns in the portal
requirement: Suppliers see receipts and returns for their orders with quantities, inspection results and PDFs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a receipt approved, When viewed, Then quantities and inspection are shown.|Given a return approved, When viewed, Then the return note is available.|Given a receipt of another supplier, When requested, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Invoices in the portal
requirement: Suppliers create order-based, receipt-based, proforma invoices and credit notes for their orders, upload their invoice document, see validations before submission, and track status, holds, disputes and payment status.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order with open lines, When the supplier creates an invoice, Then eligible lines are offered with open quantities.|Given a variance block, When submitted, Then the supplier sees the reason per line. (error case)|Given payment status received, When viewed, Then it is shown with date and reference.

title: Catalogue in the portal
requirement: Suppliers download templates, upload catalogues, see revisions with diffs and buyer comments, and current published items.
acceptance_criteria: Given an upload, When valid, Then a revision with diff appears.|Given a rejected line, When viewed, Then the buyer comment is shown.|Given no accepted revision, When items are viewed, Then an empty state explains. (edge)|Given a file over the size limit, When uploaded, Then it is refused with the limit shown. (error case)

title: Questionnaires and documents in the portal
requirement: Suppliers answer questionnaires and upload required documents with expiry dates; the portal shows what is missing for publishing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a missing mandatory document, When the home page loads, Then it is listed as a to-do.|Given a questionnaire submitted, When viewed, Then it is read-only with status.|Given an expired document, When replaced, Then the block lifts. (edge)|Given a document uploaded with an expiry date in the past, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Tasks and queries in the portal
requirement: Suppliers see tasks assigned to them (Foundation tasks), respond, attach files and resolve; buyers reopen or close.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task assigned, When the supplier resolves it, Then the buyer is notified.|Given a closed task, When the supplier tries to respond, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a task with an attachment, When opened, Then the file is downloadable.

title: Portal home
requirement: A home page with counts of orders awaiting acknowledgement, notices due, invoices by status, held or disputed invoices, documents expiring, open tasks and announcements.
acceptance_criteria: Given data, When loaded, Then counts are correct and link to lists.|Given no data, When loaded, Then zeros are shown. (edge)|Given an announcement for suppliers, When published, Then it appears.|Given a supplier user whose supplier is inactive, When the home page loads, Then a status notice is shown and actions are disabled. (error case)

title: Operational reports
requirement: The reports in section 8.4 shall be available as grids with filters, saved views and export, respecting permissions and visibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given the open orders report, When filtered by supplier, Then only that supplier's lines appear.|Given a user without the reports permission, When opening, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given export, When run, Then the file matches the grid.

title: Cycle time and first-pass match measures
requirement: The system shall compute cycle times (request to approval, approval to order, order to acknowledgement, order to receipt, invoice to approval) and the first-pass match rate (invoices approved without hold or rejection), by period, legal entity and supplier.
acceptance_criteria: Given documents in a period, When computed, Then medians and percentiles are shown.|Given an invoice with a hold later released, When counted, Then it is not first-pass.|Given no data, When viewed, Then "no data" is shown. (edge)|Given a period with inconsistent data (an approval before submission), When computed, Then the record is excluded and listed in a data quality note. (error case)

title: Budget reports
requirement: Budget consumption by line, period and document type with reserved, consumed and available, and drill-down to documents.
acceptance_criteria: Given consumption, When the report runs, Then totals match budget lines.|Given drill-down, When clicked, Then documents are listed.|Given export, When run, Then a file is produced. (edge)|Given a user without the budget report permission, When run, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Supplier reports
requirement: Supplier master reports (status, categories, documents expiring, pending changes, bank verifications) and performance indicators per period.
acceptance_criteria: Given documents expiring within 30 days, When the report runs, Then suppliers and documents are listed.|Given performance indicators, When run for a quarter, Then rates per supplier are shown.|Given export, When run, Then a file is produced. (edge)|Given a user without the supplier report permission, When run, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Analytics data feed
requirement: Daily snapshots of documents, buckets and budgets shall be exported to a defined analytics schema or file set for the analytics product.
acceptance_criteria: Given a day, When the feed runs, Then files or tables per entity are produced with a manifest.|Given a failed run, When detected, Then an alert fires. (error case)|Given a re-run, When executed, Then outputs are idempotent.

title: Document search
requirement: Users shall find requests, orders, receipts, invoices, suppliers and contracts by number, supplier, item or free text through Foundation unified search with visibility rules.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order number, When searched, Then the order appears with a link.|Given a record outside visibility, When searched, Then it is not returned.|Given no match, When searched, Then an empty state is shown. (edge)|Given a query over the allowed length, When searched, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Exports for audit and ERP
requirement: Period exports of approved documents and their approvals for auditors, and ERP-shaped exports (orders, receipts, invoices, credit notes) through export definitions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a period, When the audit export runs, Then documents with approval decisions and signatures are included.|Given an ERP export definition, When scheduled, Then files land at the destination.|Given a failed delivery, When retried, Then it alerts after the policy. (error case)

title: Document type settings
requirement: Settings per document type for budget validation and blocking, consumption trigger, multi-currency lines, approval configurations, numbering, templates, mandatory custom fields and acknowledgement reminder days.
acceptance_criteria: Given a setting changed, When the next document is created, Then it applies.|Given an invalid value, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a change, When audited, Then before and after are recorded.

title: Supplier onboarding configuration
requirement: Settings for enabled registration sections, required documents and questionnaires, bank verification rules, duplicate thresholds, portal channels and supplier defaults.
acceptance_criteria: Given a section disabled, When a supplier registers, Then it is not shown.|Given bank verification required, When a bank change is approved without checklist, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a threshold changed, When duplicate detection runs, Then the new threshold applies.

title: Matching and tolerance configuration screen
requirement: One screen for the matching configuration (FF-132) with explanations and a simulation that shows how a sample invoice would be treated.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sample invoice entered in the simulation, When run, Then the outcome per check (pass, hold, block) is shown.|Given a change saved, When audited, Then it is recorded.|Given a user without the permission, When opening, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Document templates for the product
requirement: Templates for order, change order, return note, receipt note and invoice acknowledgement per legal entity and language through Foundation templates, with product placeholders documented.
acceptance_criteria: Given a template per legal entity, When rendered, Then it is used.|Given a missing placeholder, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a preview, When requested, Then sample data renders.

title: Approval configuration starter set
requirement: A starter set of approval configurations per document type (manager chain by amount bands, budget owner for requests, finance for invoices above a threshold, procurement head for suppliers) shall be seeded as inactive examples that administrators can activate and edit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new tenant, When the console opens, Then the starter configurations exist inactive.|Given activation, When a document is submitted, Then the configuration applies.|Given an edit, When saved, Then it is versioned by Foundation workflow. (edge)|Given a starter configuration edited to reference an unknown field, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Go-live checklist and data readiness
requirement: A tenant readiness view shall show what is missing before go-live: legal entities, chart of accounts, account strings, budgets, currencies, units, taxes, templates, numbering, approval configurations, suppliers, items, users and roles, with links to fix each.
acceptance_criteria: Given missing templates, When the view loads, Then it is listed with a link.|Given all items complete, When the view loads, Then it shows ready.|Given a user without administration permission, When opening, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Country accelerator packs
requirement: Country-specific rules shall be delivered as accelerator packs installed per tenant by operators and configured by tenant administrators: reference data (tax codes and components, classifications, document types), validation rules (identifier formats, e-invoice fields), computation rules (for example Indian GST: CGST and SGST for intra-state, IGST for inter-state by place of supply, reverse charge flags) and report formats; packs are versioned and upgradable without code changes to the product.
rationale: Decision F-08: Indian GST as an accelerator pack; other countries later.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Indian GST pack installed, When an intra-state invoice line is taxed, Then CGST and SGST components are computed; inter-state produces IGST.|Given no pack installed, When a line is taxed, Then plain tax codes apply without country rules.|Given a pack upgraded, When installed, Then existing documents keep their computed values and new documents use the new rules.|Given a pack installation by a tenant administrator without operator rights, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)
notes: Decision G-05 default: operators install, tenant administrators configure.

title: Owning organisation on every record
requirement: Every master record (supplier, item, supplier item, catalogue, contract, category, tax code, payment term, ship-to location, template) and every document (request, order, shipment notice, receipt, return, invoice, credit note) shall carry an owning organisation and a sharing mode through the Foundation pattern (TF-220); documents take the organisation of the requester or buyer and never mix organisations; the organisation is shown on lists and records.
rationale: Decision F-13: separation by business unit from day one.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user of organisation A creating a request, When saved, Then the request's organisation is A.|Given a request of organisation A, When a line references an item private to organisation B, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a list, When loaded, Then the organisation column is shown and filterable.

title: Sharing modes for master data
requirement: Master data shall support the three sharing modes: global (default for categories, units, currencies, tax codes and payment terms), shared with listed organisations (for example a supplier or item used by two units), and private (visible to the owner only); administrators set the default mode per master type and may change a record's mode with audit.
rationale: Shared where it helps, separated where required.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item shared with organisations A and B, When a user of C searches, Then it is not shown.|Given a record changed from global to private, When saved, Then documents of other organisations that already reference it keep working and a warning lists them.|Given a change by a user without the master's configuration permission, When attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Supplier enablement per organisation
requirement: A supplier shall register once per tenant and be enabled per organisation with organisation-specific terms (payment and shipping terms, currency, match levels, preferred flag, status On or On Hold) and an optional organisation approval; documents of an organisation may use only suppliers enabled in it; supplier users see documents of all organisations they are enabled in, labelled by organisation.
rationale: One registration for the supplier, separate control for each unit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a supplier enabled in A but not B, When a buyer of B creates an order for it, Then it is refused with an enablement action offered. (error case)|Given organisation terms set, When an order in that organisation is created, Then the organisation's terms default.|Given a supplier user, When listing orders, Then orders of all enabling organisations appear with the organisation name.

title: Organisation-specific configuration
requirement: Numbering sequences, document templates, approval configurations, tolerances, budget validation switches, receipt approval requirement and default match levels shall be settable per organisation, overriding tenant values for records owned by that organisation (TF-221); the tenant console shows effective values per organisation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a numbering sequence for organisation A with prefix A-PO, When an order of A is issued, Then its number starts with A-PO.|Given no override for B, When an order of B is issued, Then the tenant sequence is used.|Given a template missing for both A and the tenant, When rendering, Then it is refused naming the template. (error case)

title: Document visibility by organisation
requirement: Lists and reads of documents shall be filtered by the user's organisation access (home organisation, additional organisations, parent with children for group roles); approvals, tasks and notifications shall respect the same access; cross-organisation reads of private records shall be audited.
acceptance_criteria: Given a buyer with access to A only, When listing orders, Then only A's orders appear.|Given a group role at the parent, When listing, Then orders of all children appear with the organisation shown.|Given a direct link to a document of another organisation, When opened without access, Then it is refused and audited. (error case)

title: Finance masters per legal entity and organisation
requirement: Chart of accounts, account strings, budgets and fiscal calendars belong to a legal entity; an organisation under a legal entity uses that entity's chart of accounts and may have its own budget lines; coding a document to an account string of another legal entity is refused; budgets and consumption are reported per organisation and consolidated.
acceptance_criteria: Given organisation A under legal entity L1, When a request in A is coded, Then only L1 account strings are offered.|Given a string of L2, When used on A's document, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given budget lines per organisation, When the consolidated report runs, Then totals per organisation and the group total are shown.

title: Catalogue and contract applicability per organisation
requirement: Catalogues shall be published per organisation or to all; contracts shall list the organisations they cover; browsing shows only items published to the user's organisation; contract consumption is tracked per organisation and in total.
rationale: Different units buy from different agreements.
acceptance_criteria: Given a catalogue published to A, When a user of B browses, Then its items are hidden.|Given a contract covering A and B, When an order of C references it, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given consumption by A and B, When the contract is viewed, Then per-organisation and total consumption are shown.

title: Consolidated reporting and organisation switcher
requirement: Reports and dashboards shall run per organisation and consolidated for users with group roles, with the organisation as a filter and a column; the UI organisation switcher sets the default organisation for new documents and lists.
rationale: Group functions need the whole picture.
acceptance_criteria: Given a group finance user, When the accrual report runs consolidated, Then rows show the organisation and totals per organisation and overall.|Given the switcher set to B, When a new request is created, Then its organisation is B.|Given a user without access to B, When they try to switch to B, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Organisation onboarding and lifecycle
requirement: Adding an organisation shall open a readiness checklist (legal entity link, chart of accounts, account strings, budgets, numbering, templates, approval configurations, enabled suppliers, users and roles); deactivating an organisation shall stop new documents and keep existing ones readable; merging reassigns records with audit (TF-223).
acceptance_criteria: Given a new organisation, When created, Then the checklist lists missing items with links.|Given a deactivated organisation, When a new order is attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a merge, When confirmed, Then the merged organisation's documents reference the survivor and history keeps the original organisation.

title: Supplier portal across organisations
requirement: A supplier user shall see documents, tasks and questionnaires from every organisation of the tenant that enabled the supplier, grouped or filterable by organisation, with the organisation's name, terms and contacts shown on each document; data of organisations that did not enable the supplier is never shown.
rationale: One portal for the supplier, clear separation for the buyer group.
acceptance_criteria: Given enablement in A and B, When the supplier opens orders, Then orders of A and B appear with the organisation shown.|Given no enablement in C, When the supplier opens a C document by identifier, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given an invoice created by the supplier, When saved, Then its organisation equals the order's organisation and the organisation's bill-to details apply.

title: Supplier connection and onboarding through the network
requirement: A customer's invitation shall create a connection request in the Supplier Network; a new supplier registers once (network profile and credentials) and an existing supplier accepts the request; the connection becomes a relationship linked to the customer's supplier record; the customer-specific onboarding wizard (FF-021) then runs with the network profile pre-filled.
rationale: Decision F-16: one registration for all customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing network supplier invited by a second customer, When they accept, Then no new registration is needed and the second customer's wizard opens with the profile pre-filled.|Given a new supplier, When they complete network registration, Then the first customer's wizard opens next.|Given an invitation to a tax identifier that belongs to a different registered organisation, When sent, Then the network flags the conflict to the buyer before the invitation goes out. (error case)

title: Unified inbox across customers
requirement: The supplier portal shall show one inbox of items needing action across all customers (orders awaiting acknowledgement, shipment notices due, receipts to review, invoices held or disputed, questionnaires, tasks, documents expiring) with the customer name and organisation on each item, filters by customer, type, status and due date, sorting by due date, and a count per customer.
rationale: Suppliers work for many customers; one list saves time.
acceptance_criteria: Given items from three customers, When the inbox loads, Then all appear with customer and organisation names and due dates.|Given a filter by customer B, When applied, Then only B's items appear.|Given an item whose customer unit is unreachable, When the inbox loads, Then it is marked unreachable and can be retried. (error case)

title: Customer switcher and customer context
requirement: A customer switcher shall set the active customer for all screens (orders, notices, receipts, invoices, catalogue, questionnaires, tasks, company data per customer); screens show the customer's name, organisation, terms and rules; actions run in the customer's tenant with the customer's validations.
rationale: Clear context prevents mistakes across customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given the switcher set to customer A, When orders are listed, Then only A's orders appear with A's branding context.|Given an invoice created under customer A, When submitted, Then A's matching rules and tolerances apply.|Given a user without a relationship to customer C, When they try to switch to C, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Acting on documents of several customers
requirement: Supplier users shall acknowledge orders, submit shipment notices and invoices, answer questionnaires and resolve tasks for any connected customer from the portal; bulk acknowledgement across customers shall run each item in its customer's tenant and report per item.
acceptance_criteria: Given orders from two customers selected, When bulk acknowledged, Then each is acknowledged in its tenant and the results list shows both.|Given one customer rejects an acknowledgement (order cancelled meanwhile), When the bulk action runs, Then the others succeed and the failure shows the customer's reason. (error case)|Given an invoice submitted for customer A, When saved, Then it exists only in A's tenant and the inbox item closes.

title: One profile, per-customer acceptance
requirement: The supplier shall maintain one network profile; each change shall be offered to every connected customer; the supplier shall see per customer whether a change is pending, accepted or declined with the customer's reason; customer-specific data (terms, status, preferred flag, questionnaires, customer-required documents) stays per customer.
rationale: Less duplicate maintenance for suppliers, full control for customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given an address change, When saved, Then each customer shows pending until its approval completes.|Given customer B declines with a reason, When viewed, Then the reason is shown for B only.|Given a change rejected by a customer's validation (for example an unsupported bank code format), When received, Then the supplier sees the validation message for that customer. (error case)

title: Supplier users and roles in the network
requirement: The supplier's primary contact shall manage the supplier organisation's users (invite, roles, remove) in the network; roles decide which customers and which document types a user may work (all customers by default, or a customer subset); customers may block a user for their tenant only.
rationale: Supplier organisations need their own user administration.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user limited to customers A and C, When they log in, Then B's items are not shown.|Given a user removed by the primary contact, When they try to log in, Then it is refused and sessions end. (error case)|Given customer B blocks a user, When that user opens B's items, Then they are refused for B only.

title: Supplier notifications across customers
requirement: Supplier users shall receive notifications from all customers through the network with the customer named, choose channels and digests once for all customers, and never receive a customer's internal notifications; customers keep their templates and branding in the content.
acceptance_criteria: Given orders issued by customers A and B, When the daily digest is chosen, Then one email lists both grouped by customer.|Given a customer's internal notification key, When evaluated, Then it is never routed to supplier users. (error case)|Given an immediate channel chosen for holds, When a hold occurs, Then the notification is sent at once with the customer named.

title: Relationship status and history
requirement: Suppliers shall see each customer relationship with status (connected, on hold, ended), the customer's enabled organisations, terms and performance indicators the customer chooses to share; ended relationships keep read-only history of documents for the retention period.
acceptance_criteria: Given a relationship on hold, When viewed, Then the status and the customer's message are shown and actions are disabled.|Given a customer sharing on-time delivery, When viewed, Then the indicator is shown for that customer only.|Given an ended relationship, When the supplier opens a document, Then it is read-only and no action is offered. (error case)

title: Process reference pack per module
requirement: Before the first slice of each module (finance masters, suppliers, catalogue, requests, orders, receiving, payables, contracts, supplier network experience), a process reference pack shall exist and be approved: APQC PCF activity mapping, process maps (BPMN) for the main flow and each variant and exception, standards mapping (section 2.4), benchmark indicators with targets, competitive feature review of leading suites and networks, open gaps, and a research log with sources and dates.
rationale: Decision F-17: not limited by what we know today.
acceptance_criteria: Given a module slice is scheduled, When the design review runs, Then the pack is present and approved, or the slice is blocked.|Given a pack, When reviewed, Then every requirement of the module maps to a PCF activity and a process map step, or an exclusion is recorded.|Given a pack without the competitive review, When submitted for approval, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Standards alignment of document models
requirement: The data models of orders, order responses, shipment notices, receipts, invoices and credit notes shall be mapped field by field to UBL 2.1 and Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (and UN/CEFACT where relevant); mandatory fields of the standards shall exist in the model or be recorded as exclusions with reasons; exports in UBL shall be possible for invoices and orders in a later slice.
acceptance_criteria: Given the invoice model, When compared with Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, Then every mandatory element has a field or a recorded exclusion.|Given an order, When exported as UBL (later slice), Then it validates against the schema.|Given a new field added to the invoice model, When the standards mapping is not updated, Then the review is blocked. (error case)

title: Reference data from standards
requirement: Categories shall support UNSPSC codes (with tenant-specific trees mapped to UNSPSC), items and locations shall support GS1 identifiers (GTIN, GLN), currencies ISO 4217, dates ISO 8601, locations UN/LOCODE, shipping terms Incoterms 2020, and payment status messages ISO 20022 codes, each as optional reference attributes that packs and integrations can rely on.
rationale: Common language with ERPs, suppliers and networks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a category mapped to a UNSPSC code, When exported, Then the code is included.|Given an item with a GTIN of wrong length or check digit, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given a payment status message with an ISO 20022 code, When received, Then it maps to the invoice payment state.

title: Benchmark indicators built in
requirement: The product shall compute the benchmark indicators from the research basis (first-pass match rate, invoice cycle time, order cycle time, acknowledgement time, catalogue and contract compliance, cost per order inputs, supplier on-time delivery, electronic invoice share) with the same definitions as the reference sources so that customers can compare with industry benchmarks.
rationale: Customers judge the product by these numbers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a quarter of data, When indicators compute, Then each shows value, definition and the reference it follows.|Given a definition changed in a later version, When computed, Then both the old and new values are available for the transition period. (edge)|Given insufficient data, When computed, Then the indicator shows "insufficient data" with the minimum needed. (error case)

title: External practitioner review
requirement: Each process reference pack and each module design shall be reviewed by at least one external practitioner with recent experience of a leading suite or network; review findings shall be recorded with disposition (accepted, deferred, rejected with reason) before the first slice of the module starts.
rationale: Independent challenge of the team's assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a review completed, When the module slice starts, Then the findings and dispositions are recorded.|Given a module without a review record, When the slice is scheduled, Then it is blocked. (error case)|Given a deferred finding, When the next version is planned, Then it appears in the backlog with its source.

title: Research log and living process documentation
requirement: The research log (sources, dates, findings, decisions) and the process maps shall be kept with the product documentation, updated with each release that changes a process, and published to customers as process documentation per module.
acceptance_criteria: Given a release that changes a process, When published, Then the process map version matches the release.|Given a customer administrator, When they open process documentation, Then the current maps and variants are shown.|Given a process change merged without a documentation update, When the release checklist runs, Then it is blocked. (error case)
